commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
npm install -g jsvu@3.0.5
jsvu --os=linux64 v8@15.6.61
jsvu --os=linux64 spidermonkey@156.0.1
jsvu --os=linux64 javascriptcore@319571

commands.step: Compare each engine to the golden hash
commands.text:
set -euo pipefail
golden=$(tr -d '\r\n' < fixtures/golden.txt)
v8=$("$HOME/.jsvu/bin/v8-15.6.61" --module harness/sim.mjs | tr -d '\r\n')
sm=$("$HOME/.jsvu/bin/spidermonkey-156.0.1" -m harness/sim.mjs | tr -d '\r\n')
jsc=$("$HOME/.jsvu/bin/javascriptcore-319571" -m harness/sim.mjs | tr -d '\r\n')
if [ "$v8" != "$golden" ] || [ "$sm" != "$golden" ] || [ "$jsc" != "$golden" ]; then
  echo "v8 [$v8]"
  echo "spidermonkey [$sm]"
  echo "javascriptcore [$jsc]"
  echo "golden [$golden]"
  exit 1
fi
echo "three engines match"
